rules.text: Every feature has a documented issue, a bounded commit, and a relevant test group.
rules.enforcement: auto: strict test groups, Definition of Ready and Done

rules.text: All Supabase schema changes are ordered CLI migrations and are reproducible from an empty local database plus seed.
rules.enforcement: auto: the database deploy workflow proves migrations on an empty local database

rules.text: Every role check is enforced server-side and, where direct database access is possible, by RLS. Hiding a button is not authorization.
No development command silently reaches hosted production.
rules.enforcement: auto: Claude Code guard rules and local-db safety tests

rules.text: No frontend environment value contains a private service or R2 credential.
Data updates are idempotent where retried; score/event corrections recalculate dependent standings and fantasy points safely.
User-facing errors, empty states, loading states, and responsive behavior are acceptance criteria, not optional polish.
No production media URL, key, team name, division ordering, bracket label, or match-share text remains hard-coded where the requirement says it is dictator-configurable.
Current behavior stays available until its replacement passes parity and the cutover is approved.

A capability a person uses or configures ships a minimally usable flow in the existing frontend in its own item and phase (real authorized action; loading, empty, success and error states; UI-to-API-to-database path tested locally and on staging). The Phase 9 redesign consolidates and refines; it is never where a feature first becomes usable. Backend infrastructure and security changes need no UI. World Cup stays separate from division flows.
rules.enforcement: attest: n/a for items with no user-facing capability
